en.title: The Village of Silence and the Rusted God-Machine
en.premise: Deep within the fog-shrouded village of Tsugumura lies a bizarre, ancient custom dedicated to the "Iron God." Seeking his missing older brother, a young man named Minato visits the village. Guided by a "secret map" found in an old storehouse—part cartography, part circuit diagram—he steps foot into the forbidden depths of the mountains. Awaiting him there is a "lost artificial intelligence," left behind in the wilderness and transformed into an object of worship. The village festival proves to be a ritual of inhuman logic, designed to satisfy the hunger of a god.

zh.title: 噤之里与生锈的神机
zh.premise: 隐匿于浓雾之中的噤村，自古以来便流传着供奉“铁之神”的奇异风俗。为了寻找失踪的哥哥，青年凑来到了这座村庄。他凭借着在一座古老仓库中找到的一张既像地图又像电路图的“秘密地图”，踏入了被视为禁忌的深山之中。在那里等待着他的，是遗留于山野之中、并已异变为信仰的“迷路人工智能”。村庄的祭典，其实是一场为了填补神明饥饿而展开的非人逻辑仪式。
